dedupe_keys.name: portofino park orthophotos for illegal building monitoring 20022003

description: Region of Liguria publishes GeoTIFF colour orthophotos acquired for monitoring illegal building in Portofino Park, from flights on 22 February 2002, 10 September 2002 and 16 October 2003. Coverage is Portofino Park. The explicitly stated building-monitoring purpose establishes a built-stock observation input for exposure or building-development simulations. The grouped resource has 9 native metadata entries; versions, map sheets and complementary representations are retained together where the provider defines the same resource. The metadata permits public access and states a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Metadata is publicly readable; charges for obtaining or using the underlying material are not established here. Access is through the linked native metadata, which lists the provider routes and declared formats. This is historical imagery with a 15-centimetre ground resolution, not a classified building inventory. No building extraction or change-detection result is inferred. Accuracy and current completeness remain unverified. No distribution, map, feature or document body was downloaded. Descriptive metadata dates range from 2022-05-19 to 2022-05-19; these dates are not treated as asset observation dates. Related regional or municipal inventories describe other physical assets or broader source catalogues.
